beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Added filing and management of learning-period work samples directly from Schoology course activity.
• Added four-square headers as the default for new work samples and clarified folder setup instructions.
• Improved update preparation feedback, including installation feedback on Mac and invitations to try newer betas after checking for stable updates.
• Added instructions for recovering uploads that are missing saved work dates.

stable.notes:
Fixes:
• Fixed the sample verification window reporting "All fields verified" when the date box was still empty. An automatically read date was stamped on the sample and counted as checked without ever being shown, so it could be saved without anyone seeing it.
